name: Ripe Crop Marker
summary: Puts a tiny sparkle on top of every fully grown crop, so you can spot what is ready to harvest from across the field.
logoPrompt: A single ripe golden wheat stalk on a small block of tilled farmland with a bright four-pointed pixel sparkle at its tip

cover.tagline: See which crops are ready at a glance.

description: **Ripe Crop Marker adds a small sparkle to the top of every fully grown crop, so you can tell at a glance which plants are ready to harvest.**
- Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots and nether wart show a five-pixel sparkle once they reach their last growth stage.
- Every earlier stage looks exactly like vanilla, so a half-grown field never shows a false sparkle.
- The sparkle is the same warm white and gold on every crop and lighter than any leaf or ear, so it stands out on grass, soil and soul sand.
- It is drawn onto the vanilla textures, pixel for pixel, and keeps the vanilla look.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Walk along your farm and harvest the plants that sparkle.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only replaces five crop textures, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Items, seeds, growth speed and drops stay vanilla.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Missing a crop or want a different marker? Leave a comment.
